sentences.en: The substance is light enough to float on the water.
sentences.zh: 这种物质轻得能在水上漂浮。

sentences.en: Water and ice are the same substance in different forms.
sentences.zh: 水和冰是同一种物质的不同形态。

sentences.en: Antigens are substances capable of provoking the formation of antibodies.
sentences.zh: 抗原是能引发抗体形成的物质。

senses.zh: 物质主旨, 要旨实质, 本体Substance
